item.title: Schumer calls Trump 'a military moron' and says US 'worse off' now than when Iran war started
item.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer blasts President Donald Trump as "a military moron" over the Iran conflict, saying Americans are "worse off."

item.title: Hegseth snaps at 'rude' reporter for interrupting Pentagon briefing on Iran
item.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth scolded a reporter for interrupting during a Pentagon briefing on Iran, telling her to “just wait" as he called on another journalist.

item.title: Gas surge tied to Iran conflict hits swing states, testing Trump’s low-price pitch
item.summary: Rising gas prices are becoming a central political battleground as Democrats tie fuel costs to Trump's Iran conflict ahead of midterm elections.

item.title: New Florida law targeting alleged 'jihad' puts state 'ahead of the curve,' DeSantis says
item.summary: Gov. Ron DeSantis defends a new Florida law allowing state officials to designate terrorist organizations and block public funds allegedly tied to jihad.

item.title: Minnesota high school softball season faces strain of trans athlete conflict as Trump admin cracks down
item.summary: Champlin Park High School's trans softball pitcher returns amid the DOJ's Title IX lawsuit against Minnesota over biological males in girls' sports.

item.title: GOP infighting replaces clash with Dems, derails path to end historic DHS shutdown
item.summary: House Republicans reject the Senate's Department of Homeland Security spending plan, with the Freedom Caucus pushing to fund the entire department through budget reconciliation.

item.title: Two Oklahoma elementary school workers charged with assaulting students
item.summary: Two Elgin Elementary School employees face assault charges after allegedly attacking students, including a 5-year-old reportedly held in a chokehold.

item.title: Americans headed to popular mountain region face travel advisory for natural disasters and unrest
item.summary: The U.S. State Department updated its Nepal travel advisory to Level 2, urging increased caution after nationwide protests that began in September ended.

item.title: California fraud concerns ramp up as man pleads guilty to massive scheme using taxpayers as his 'piggy bank'
item.summary: Paul Randall, 66, pleads guilty to wire fraud in a scheme that authorities say defrauded Medi-Cal out of more than $178 million in taxpayer funds.

item.title: DAVID MARCUS: How airport duty melted Democrats' absurd smearing of ICE
item.summary: ICE agents helping at airports are winning over travelers and critics alike, even as Democrats continue the DHS funding shutdown over enforcement tactics.
